name: Lumibird S.A.
summary: Lumibird SA specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of laser devices. Headquartered in Lannion, Bretagne, the company employs 541 dedicated full-time staff. Its extensive product offering includes various laser types such as compact pulsed and double-pulse Nd lasers, customizable laser systems, flash-lamp pumped lasers, diode-pumped solid-state lasers, semiconductor laser modules, and powerful intense pulsed light instruments. Lumibird provides its advanced laser solutions to a broad spectrum of clients, spanning industrial, scientific, and medical sectors. The firm operates globally through key subsidiaries, including Quantel Medical, which focuses on diagnostic ocular ultrasound systems and surgical lasers; Quantel USA, renowned for designing and producing fiber, glass, and tunable laser systems; and Quantel Derma AT, which concentrates on laser technology for dermatological and aesthetic applications.
